description: Planned v2 benchmark runs (PLAN-v2 Phase 6). scripts/bench.py expands each run into one results file per (task set, seed) and runs them in order with --resume. Block 6.3 (quantisation study, R-QV-1) uses the exact Ollama tags checked on 2026-11-09. The Groq delay (30 s) keeps the request and per-minute token rates well under the published limits; the daily token limit is the binding one (see docs/NOTES.md). CHECKPOINT C decisions (user): Groq repair + verify, seeds 0-1, spread over several days with `--units`; a prompt-v2 repair block (6.1b) for the R-REF-1 comparison; Groq and local blocks never run at the same time.

runs.note: R-REF-1 like-for-like: the same as the 6.1 repair runs but with prompt v2, to compare v2 and v3 at identical settings

Groq; seeds 0-1 and no baseline mode to fit the daily token limit (user decision at CHECKPOINT C). Reasoning model: output tokens include hidden reasoning, so TTFT and tokens/s are not comparable with local rows. Never run at the same time as a local block.
